age.evidence: Patients with AATR (n = 15, aged 20–45 years) and healthy control individuals were recruited in the First Teaching Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, China, from 2015 to 2017.

material_type.evidence: Achilles tendon tissue samples from 15 cases were obtained from biopsies removed during surgery for rupture or open wounds (six cases) and from small tissue samples (dimension of 2 × 2 × 2 mm) removed during a needle biopsy (nine cases).

sample_source.evidence: Achilles tendon tissue samples from 15 cases were obtained from biopsies removed during surgery for rupture or open wounds (six cases) and from small tissue samples (dimension of 2 × 2 × 2 mm) removed during a needle biopsy (nine cases).

sex.evidence: Among the six male patients who underwent surgery (average age, 29.33 ± 3.83 years; range, 25–36 years), AATR involved the left limb in four patients and the right limb in two patients.
